parse_protobuf_message: parse serialized protocol buffer binary data into a protobuf message using ParseFromString
serialize_protobuf_message: serialize a protobuf message to a binary string using SerializeToString with deterministic ordering
merge_protobuf_messages: merge the contents of one protobuf message into another using MergeFrom to combine fields
check_protobuf_field_presence: check if a specific field is set in a protobuf message using HasField or the contains operator
list_protobuf_fields: list all non-empty fields in a protobuf message as field descriptor and value tuples using ListFields
